headlines.title: CNN, Politico and MS NOW plan to sue Trump admin over ban on White House coverage
headlines.description: NBC, ABC, CBS and Fox News also declined to step in and provide pool coverage of the president after CNN was banned from doing so on Monday.

headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk Poll found that 69% of respondents oppose building AI data centers in their areas, with 45% saying they “strongly oppose” the idea.

headlines.title: News networks refuse to provide pool coverage of White House after CNN was banned
headlines.description: Television news networks are now refusing to provide pool coverage of President Trump's activities at the White House after the administration banned CNN, MS NOW and Politico. NBC News' Garrett Haake has details on the latest developments between the president and the media.

headlines.title: 3 media outlets sue Trump admin. over ban on White House coverage: 'This threatens press freedom'
headlines.description: CNN, Politico and MS NOW filed a lawsuit Monday against the Trump administration after President Donald Trump banned them from covering the White House. NBC News' Gary Grumbach reports on the legal filing and the latest comments from VP Vance.
